questionText: Flipkart has partnered with which bank and payment gateway to launch biometric authentication (fingerprint/Face ID) for card payments?
explanation: Flipkart partnered with Axis Bank & PayU to launch biometric authentication for card payments without needing OTPs, aligning with RBI's 2025 Digital Payment Directions.

questionText: Which fintech entity recently secured Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approval for its NBFC application, forming the subsidiary 'MFSPL'?
explanation: RBI approved MobiKwik's NBFC application, enabling entry into regulated lending under subsidiary MobiKwik Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. (MFSPL).

questionText: What is the maximum balance limit permitted under the newly launched India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) Self Help Group (SHG) Savings Account?
explanation: IPPB launched a zero-balance, zero-charge SHG Savings Account with a maximum balance limit of ₹2,00,000 to boost rural women empowerment.

questionText: According to the latest figures, how much did the National Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd (NARCL) recover in FY 2025-26?
explanation: NARCL recovered over ₹4,364 crore in FY26 across 23 borrower accounts, taking cumulative recoveries to ₹6,345 crore (~70% of total).

questionText: The World Bank has sanctioned a ₹2,800 crore loan for Gurugram Metro Phase II. What percentage of the total project cost does this loan constitute?
explanation: The ₹2,800 crore loan provided by World Bank constitutes exactly 60% of the total project cost for Gurugram Metropolitan Rail Limited.
memoryTrick: World Bank Gurugram: ₹2,800 Cr = 60% project cost

questionText: Jio Payments Bank Limited (JPBL) has partnered with which fintech platform as a Business Correspondent (BC) to strengthen last-mile rural digital banking?
explanation: Jio Payments Bank partnered with Ezeepay as Business Correspondent to expand digital banking access through local merchant outlets in rural & semi-urban India.

questionText: World Bank approved a loan of USD 500 million (~₹4,750 crore) to the Bihar State Government for which development programme?
explanation: The USD 500 million loan supports the Bihar Urban Transformation Programme, following plans for 11 new greenfield satellite townships.

questionText: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd (KMBL) received RBI approval to acquire up to what percentage stake each in AU Small Finance Bank and Federal Bank?
explanation: RBI permitted KMBL to acquire up to 9.99% of paid-up capital/voting rights in both AU Small Finance Bank and Federal Bank.
memoryTrick: Trick: Nine-point-nine-nine stake in AU & Federal

questionText: AU Small Finance Bank launched four new credit cards. Which card is specifically tailored for 'Affluent Achievers' with premium lounge access?
explanation: AU Ananta targets affluent achievers with premium travel and lounge access. AU Laksya is for Gen Z, AU Tejas for young salaried, and AU Prathama for first-time credit users.

questionText: CTBC Bank recently became the first bank from which country to open a branch at GIFT City, Gujarat?
explanation: CTBC Bank is the first Taiwanese bank to establish a branch at GIFT City, Gujarat, after receiving IFSCA regulatory approval.

questionText: ICICI Bank partnered with Visa to launch India's first USD-denominated debit card for NRI customers from which banking unit?

options.text: IFSC Banking Unit (IBU) at GIFT City

explanation: Issued from ICICI's IFSC Banking Unit (IBU) at GIFT City on the Visa Infinite platform, linked to USD Global Savings Accounts.
memoryTrick: ICICI = Instrument First (USD Card at GIFT City)

questionText: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma inaugurated India's 1st AI-powered 'Phygital' banking branch in Guwahati for which bank?
explanation: India's first AI-powered 'Phygital' (Physical + Advanced Digital) branch of Slice Small Finance Bank was inaugurated in Guwahati.
memoryTrick: Slice SFB = 1st AI Phygital in Guwahati

questionText: Hyderabad-based Viyona Fintech India Pvt. Ltd. received NPCI certifications for which of the following services?

options.text: UPI Acquirer, UPI Issuer, IMPS, and IBMB

explanation: NPCI certified Viyona Fintech across 4 major dimensions: UPI Acquirer, UPI Issuer, IMPS, and IBMB (Interoperable Mobile Banking).

questionText: FinBox launched an AI-lending infrastructure platform named 'Atlas'. By how much does Atlas reduce loan processing time?
explanation: Atlas cuts loan application processing time from roughly 3 weeks to 24 hours, addressing the ~70% drop-off rate in loan applications.

questionText: Mahindra & Mahindra signed an MoU with which foreign bank to launch India's first sustainability-linked dealer financing in the automotive sector?
explanation: Mahindra partnered with DBS Bank India where loan interest rates for dealers are linked directly to ESG performance and sales metrics.

questionText: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹25,000 crore Maritime Development Fund. Which entity was appointed as Fund Manager for the ₹20,000 crore Maritime Investment Fund (MIF)?
explanation: SBI Ventures was appointed fund manager for the ₹20,000 Cr MIF, registered as a closed-end Category I/II AIF under SEBI with 49% Central Govt contribution.

questionText: PFRDA formed the 'SAARG' committee to examine new asset classes for NPS. Who is appointed as the Chairman of this committee?
explanation: The SAARG (Strategic Asset Allocation & Risk Governance) committee is chaired by Narayan Ramachandran to enhance pension returns for over 2.17 crore NPS subscribers.

questionText: The Delhi e-Governance Society signed an MoU with State Bank of India (SBI) to launch which electronic payment solution on its e-procurement portal?
explanation: Delhi Govt partnered with SBI to deploy 'e-Pay' for faster, paperless, and transparent electronic payments across Delhi Govt's procurement portal.

questionText: As per the IRDAI Insurance Ombudsman FY 2025-26 report, what percentage of resolved complaints were decided in favour of policyholders across the 18 centres?
explanation: Out of 41,055 complaints resolved by the 18 Ombudsman centres, ~79% were decided in favour of policyholders for claims up to ₹50 lakh.
memoryTrick: Trick: 41K complaints, 79% in favour, 18 centres, 50L limit
